document.title: Stop agents rediscovering how to drive the host window, and fix four repo traps
document.summary: Adds `scripts/gui-drive.sh` and rewrites the manual-testing skill around it, moves device lessons from agent memory into the repo docs, fixes four traps (root-owned Docker output, a demo section count kept in three places, Pages republish deleting PR evidence, a per-harness stb_ds implementation), corrects the Linux setup notes, documents trying unreleased packages, and moves the review rules into `CODING_STANDARDS.md`.
document.why: A retro of recent agent sessions found agents lose time on stale or missing know-how rather than on finding code ([PR #150](source:s1), [retro session](source:s2)).

sources.label: PR #150
sources.title: docs(agents): stop agents rediscovering how to drive the host window, and fix four repo traps
sources.gist: Fixes the retro's top six findings: GUI driving docs, device lessons, Docker ownership, demo section count, Pages evidence, stb_ds.

sources.label: Claude Code retro session · Nov 5
sources.gist: Retro of 10 sessions across ubuntu-pc and the MacBook Pro; the user asked to fix items 1-6.

parts.name: GUI driving
parts.summary: A script and skill text for driving and recording the host window without computerUse.

parts.name: Device lessons
parts.summary: FTP and Vita3K lessons move from one machine's agent memory into the repo docs.

parts.name: Docker ownership
parts.summary: The smoke Docker run hands all its build output back to the host user.

parts.name: Demo section count
parts.summary: One shared demo section count, checked at compile time, with a pointer at the section list.

parts.name: Pages evidence
parts.summary: Republishing a PR review keeps its evidence/ screenshots.

parts.name: stb_ds once
parts.summary: The stb_ds implementation compiles once in vitadeck_core.

parts.name: Setup docs
parts.summary: Linux setup notes and a recipe for trying the SDK and companion before they reach npm.

parts.name: Review standards
parts.summary: The judgment rules reviewers apply move from AGENTS.md into CODING_STANDARDS.md.

groups.title: gui-drive.sh and the manual-testing skill
groups.why: Agents on ubuntu-pc, over SSH and on the MacBook Pro had no tmux or computerUse, so each one worked out window driving from scratch ([retro](source:s2)).
groups.summary: The skill's run, drive and recording steps now point at `scripts/gui-drive.sh`, which wraps xdotool and ffmpeg on Linux and a compiled Swift CGEvent helper on macOS.

attention.note: On macOS every `key` and `click` activates the vitadeck app with `activateIgnoringOtherApps`, taking focus from whatever the user is doing. Without it, CGEvent keys reach the frontmost app instead. The macOS path compiled and ran on the MacBook Pro, but keys and clicks there are untested.

fileNotes.scripts/gui-drive.sh: New: key, click, shot and rect on Linux X11 and macOS.
fileNotes..agents/skills/vitadeck-manual-testing/S: Drops tmux; adds Xvfb, log file, recording and Host Control fixes; calls the script from out/.

groups.title: FTP and Vita3K lessons in the repo
groups.why: The one-upload FTP rule and the Vita3K headless limits lived only in ubuntu-pc's agent memory, and a follow-up FTP listing crashed the Vita ([retro](source:s2)).
groups.summary: Footgun 6 in `AGENTS.md` becomes the single statement of the FTP rule, the build skill points at it, and the emulator skill gains the headless, `active-package.txt` and `config.yml` facts.

fileNotes..agents/skills/vitadeck-build/SKILL.md: Replaces its own copy of the rule with a pointer to footgun 6.
fileNotes..agents/skills/vitadeck-emulator/SKILL.m: Adds Deck App choice, config rewrite, headless limits and log garbling.
fileNotes.AGENTS.md: Footgun 6 forbids a listing or size check after an upload; the hunk also holds the standards pointer.

groups.title: smoke-docker.sh restores ownership on exit
groups.why: Root-owned `js/packages/sdk/dist` from a smoke run made the next host `pnpm build` fail with EACCES in two sessions ([retro](source:s2)).
groups.summary: The chown moves into `restore_ownership`, runs from an EXIT trap set at the top of `run_inside`, and now also covers `js/packages/*/dist` and `js/examples/*/.vitadeck`.

groups.title: Shared demo section count
groups.why: Adding the Sound section left `ROUNDS` and the bench `demo-scroll` keys stale with every test passing; only a reviewer caught it ([retro](source:s2)).
groups.summary: `ROUNDS` in `deck_app_input_harness.c` comes from `DEMO_SECTION_COUNT`, `smoke_harness.c` static-asserts its `PAGES` length against it, and a comment above `SECTIONS` in the demo names every file that changes with a section.

fileNotes.tests/deck_app_input_harness.c: ROUNDS uses the shared count; also drops its stb_ds copy.
fileNotes.tests/smoke_harness.c: Static assert ties PAGES to the shared count.
fileNotes.js/examples/demo/src/App.tsx: Comment lists the harnesses and bench keys tied to SECTIONS.
fileNotes..agents/skills/vitadeck-smoke/SKILL.md: Points at the App.tsx comment instead of naming two files.
fileNotes.AGENTS.md: The js/examples line points at the comment; the hunk also holds setup lines.

groups.title: Republish keeps evidence/
groups.why: Refreshing a review replaced `pr/<n>/` whole and deleted the screenshots the PR body links to ([retro](source:s2)).
groups.summary: `publishPagesReview` clears every entry of the dest folder except `EVIDENCE_DIR` before copying the new export in, and the pages skill and `AGENTS.md` say where screenshots go.

attention.note: Old evidence files are never removed by a republish: a screenshot dropped from the PR body stays hosted until the PR closes and the workflow prunes `pr/<n>/`. A new export's own `evidence/` merges over the kept one, replacing files with the same name.

fileNotes..agents/skills/pages/scripts/pages-revie: Keeps evidence/ when it clears the dest folder.
fileNotes..agents/skills/pages/SKILL.md: Says where PR screenshots go and that republish keeps them.
fileNotes.AGENTS.md: PR rule points at the pages evidence/ folder.

groups.title: stb_ds implementation in vitadeck_core
groups.why: A harness that linked `emoji_pack.c` failed until it defined `STB_DS_IMPLEMENTATION` itself, which two sessions rediscovered ([retro](source:s2)).
groups.summary: `src/core/stb_ds.c` joins `VITADECK_CORE_SOURCES` and holds the only `STB_DS_IMPLEMENTATION`, so `main.c`, the harnesses and the fixture comment drop theirs.

fileNotes.CMakeLists.txt: Adds src/core/stb_ds.c to the core sources.
fileNotes.tests/instance_fixture.h: Drops the comment saying harnesses define the implementation.
fileNotes.tests/smoke_harness.c: Drops its copy; the hunk also adds the demo_sections.h include.
fileNotes.tests/deck_app_input_harness.c: Drops its copy, in the same hunk as the ROUNDS change.

groups.title: Setup notes and the pre-release recipe
groups.why: Agents hit corepack picking the wrong pnpm, found raylib 5.5 unpackaged on Ubuntu 26.04, and rebuilt a pack-and-install pipeline three times ([retro](source:s2)).
groups.summary: `AGENTS.md` Setup gains the corepack and raylib-from-source notes and points at the new "Try the packages before they are on npm" section of `docs/releasing.md`.

fileNotes.AGENTS.md: Corepack and raylib setup notes; the hunk also holds the demo examples line.
fileNotes.docs/releasing.md: New pack, install and scaffold recipe, tested against 0.6.1.

groups.title: CODING_STANDARDS.md
groups.why: Review delegates were handed `AGENTS.md` as the standards file because the repo had none ([retro](source:s2)).
groups.summary: The "Hit every surface" rules move from `AGENTS.md` into `CODING_STANDARDS.md` with new ADR, manifest and glossary checks, and `AGENTS.md` keeps a one-paragraph pointer.

attention.note: Implementing agents no longer see the surface rules in their always-loaded context, only the pointer naming them. Reviews now carry those rules, so a miss surfaces in review rather than during implementation.

fileNotes.CODING_STANDARDS.md: New: surface rules plus ADR, docs and glossary checks.
fileNotes.AGENTS.md: Section shrinks to a pointer; the hunk also holds footgun 6.

groups.title: Harnesses drop the define and the unused include
groups.why: These harnesses defined the implementation and use no stb_ds macros themselves.
groups.summary: The same two-line removal of `#define STB_DS_IMPLEMENTATION` and `#include "stb_ds.h"` repeats; read one and skip the rest.

groups.title: Harnesses drop the define
groups.why: These harnesses get stb_ds through `instance_fixture.h` or use it directly, so only the define goes.
groups.summary: The same one-line removal of `#define STB_DS_IMPLEMENTATION` repeats; read one and skip the rest.

groups.title: The implementation moves out of main.c
groups.why: `main.c` held the implementation the host binary linked.
groups.summary: A pure move of the two implementation lines from `src/main.c` into `src/core/stb_ds.c`; safe to skip.

commits.subject: docs(skills): call gui-drive.sh from out/, where the testing steps run
commits.author: Máté Molnár

commits.subject: docs: move the review rules into CODING_STANDARDS.md
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Review delegates were handed AGENTS.md as the standards file. The judgment rules now live in CODING_STANDARDS.md, with the ADR, manifest and glossary checks reviewers missed, and AGENTS.md keeps a pointer.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: docs: Ubuntu 26.04 setup and trying the SDK before it is on npm
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Agents hit corepack picking the wrong pnpm from the repo root, found raylib 5.5 unpackaged on Ubuntu 26.04, and rebuilt a pack-and-install pipeline three times to test the scaffold against unreleased packages.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: docs(skills): drive the host window without computerUse; move device lessons into the repo
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Agents rediscovered how to drive and record the raylib window in most recent sessions: the manual-testing skill pointed at tmux and computerUse, which agents on ubuntu-pc, over SSH and on the MacBook Pro do not have. scripts/gui-drive.sh sends keys and clicks and takes screenshots on Linux (xdotool, ffmpeg, Xvfb) and macOS (a Swift CGEvent helper), and the skill now covers headless runs and recording. The FTP single-upload rule and the Vita3K headless limits lived only in one machine's agent memory.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix(pages): keep a PR's evidence/ folder when republishing its review
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Refreshing a review replaced pr/<n>/ whole and deleted the screenshots the PR body links to.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix(scripts): smoke-docker hands all its build output back, also on failure
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
The chown missed js/packages/*/dist and js/examples/*/.vitadeck and only ran after a successful run, so the next host pnpm build failed with EACCES.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: test: share the demo section count between the smoke and input harnesses
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Adding the Sound section left deck_app_input_harness's ROUNDS and bench.c's demo-scroll keys stale without any test failing. ROUNDS now comes from DEMO_SECTION_COUNT, which smoke_harness asserts against PAGES, and a comment above SECTIONS in the demo lists everything that changes with a section.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: build: compile the stb_ds implementation once in vitadeck_core
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Every harness and main.c defined STB_DS_IMPLEMENTATION itself, so a new harness that pulled in a core file using stb_ds failed to link until it added another copy.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
